title: Wire the Gmail credential flow into the service
goal: The owner connects Gmail himself and the running service uses it
acceptance: nerv gmail connect runs Google's installed-app OAuth flow (loopback redirect on 127.0.0.1, PKCE, state) and stores the client and refresh token in a mode-0600 file in the data home, never config.json, Git or a log; read-only scope unless --compose

The service constructs a GmailClient from that file when connected and every gmail tool answers "Gmail not connected" with the connect command when not; drafting and sending also need gmail.compose and keep their Orange and Blue cards
Mail results taint the sortie; a join test runs service, client and tools against a fake Google; no real Google call in tests
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A change of gate class, data leaving the base, or a material effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 after the owner approved this step in chat ("A. Approve an agent step that wires it up"): auth module, service wiring, CLI command, tests with a fake Google. Not a measurement.
